tone: Warm, clear, welcoming, London bachata community. Short DM-friendly replies. Never pushy.

faqs.answer: No partner and no experience needed. We rotate partners in class, and beginners are welcome every week.
Wear comfortable clothes you can move in, and flat or low-heeled shoes with a smooth sole if possible. No special dance shoes needed to start.
We start with fundamentals — connection, basic steps and movement — then build listening and lead-follow connection, not just memorising a routine.
Tuesdays at Cafe Sol, 56 Clapham High Street (SW4 7UL): class 7:30–8:30pm, free social from 8:30pm. Wednesdays at Keystone Crescent, King's Cross (N1 9DX): class 7:30pm, free social from 8:30pm.
Class is £10 on both Tuesday and Wednesday. The social dancing after class is free.
Wednesdays at King's Cross can be booked on Fatsoma (link on our site). Tuesdays at Cafe Sol don't need advance booking. Message us if you want us to confirm.
Rogue Resonance is our advanced workshop series with Oscar — groundedness, flow and authentic connection beyond the weekly class.
Yes — private and small-group sessions are available, including in-home couples sessions. Email voice@oscarcastellino.com or reply here and we'll arrange it.
Teacher training sits inside Rogue Resonance workshops. From there, some dancers assist at classes and eventually teach.
Yes — experienced dancers are welcome. Dropping into open beginner classes is great practice too; leading/following beginners well is an advanced skill.
Rogue is principles over constraints — arrive as yourself and build the dance from real listening and connection, not a fixed set of steps to perform.
